title: Project Base Setup — AI Spend Audit
description: Initialize the entire project foundation from a blank repo. After completing this task, the project should have a working Next.js app with all dependencies, folder structure, environment config, and first deploy to Vercel.

commands: npx shadcn@latest add button input label card select badge separator toast progress

steps.title: Supabase database setup
sql: create table audits (id text primary key, input jsonb not null, recommendations jsonb not null, total_monthly_savings numeric not null, total_annual_savings numeric not null, ai_summary text, is_high_savings boolean default false, created_at timestamp with time zone default now());

create table leads (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), email text not null, company_name text, role text, team_size integer, audit_id text references audits(id), created_at timestamp with time zone default now());
create table rate_limits (ip text primary key, count integer default 1, window_start timestamp with time zone default now());
alter table audits enable row level security;
alter table leads enable row level security;
alter table rate_limits enable row level security;
create policy "audits public read" on audits for select using (true);
create policy "audits service insert" on audits for insert with check (true);
create policy "leads service insert" on leads for insert with check (true);
create policy "rate_limits all" on rate_limits using (true) with check (true);

steps.title: Write audit engine
steps.cursor_prompt:
Write the complete contents of src/lib/auditEngine.ts.
Pure functions only. Zero API calls. Zero side effects.

Imports: types from src/types/index.ts, pricing from src/lib/pricing.ts

Build:

1. analyzeToolEntry(entry: ToolEntry, input: AuditInput): ToolRecommendation
   Check in order:
   a) SEAT OPTIMIZATION: Claude Team min5 seats, ChatGPT Team min2, Copilot Enterprise vs Business
   b) SAME VENDOR DOWNGRADE: Claude Max->Pro for writing/research, Cursor Business->Pro for 1 seat
   c) CROSS TOOL ALTERNATIVE: coding->Windsurf Pro($15) cheapest; writing->drop duplicate tools; research->Claude Pro cheapest
   d) ALREADY OPTIMAL: savings=0, type='right-sized'
   Rules: savings=Math.max(0, current-recommended), annualSavings=savings*12, reason must have real $ numbers

2. runAudit(input: AuditInput): Omit<AuditResult, 'id'|'aiSummary'|'createdAt'>
   Sum all savings. isHighSavings = totalMonthlySavings > 500.

3. generateAuditSummaryPrompt(result, input): string
   Returns Anthropic prompt for ~100 word CFO-style paragraph.
   Include: savings, top 2 recs, use case, team size.
   Mention Credex only if savings > $500/mo.

Export: runAudit, generateAuditSummaryPrompt only. TypeScript strict.
steps.commit: feat: audit engine with seat optimization, downgrade, cross-tool logic

steps.title: Write Anthropic integration
steps.cursor_prompt:
Write the complete contents of src/lib/anthropic.ts.

Imports: Anthropic from @anthropic-ai/sdk, types, generateAuditSummaryPrompt from auditEngine

Export:
async function generateAISummary(result: Omit<AuditResult, 'aiSummary'>, input: AuditInput): Promise<string>
- Model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514, max_tokens: 200
- System: 'You are a concise financial analyst. Direct, specific. No fluff. Under 120 words. Plain paragraph, no bullets.'
- On ANY error: return fallback template paragraph with real numbers from result. Must look like a real summary not an error. Fill in: total spend, tool count, savings, top rec, annual savings. Mention Credex if isHighSavings. Say optimized if savings < 100.
- Log errors, never throw.

TypeScript strict.
steps.commit: feat: Anthropic API integration with graceful fallback

steps.title: Write API routes

files.cursor_prompt:
Write src/app/api/audit/route.ts — Next.js 14 App Router POST handler.

Steps:
1. Get IP from x-forwarded-for or x-real-ip
2. checkRateLimit(ip) — 429 if blocked
3. Parse body as AuditInput
4. Validate: tools.length >= 1, teamSize > 0, valid useCase — 400 if invalid
5. Honeypot: if body.website non-empty, return fake { success: true, id: 'fake-'+nanoid(6) }
6. runAudit(input)
7. generateAISummary(auditData, input)
8. Build AuditResult with nanoid(10) id and createdAt
9. saveAudit(audit)
10. Return { id, totalMonthlySavings, totalAnnualSavings, isHighSavings }

try/catch, 500 on unexpected error. TypeScript strict.

Write src/app/api/leads/route.ts — Next.js 14 App Router POST handler.

Steps:
1. Parse body: { email, companyName?, role?, teamSize?, auditId, phone? }
2. Honeypot: if body.phone non-empty, return { success: true } immediately
3. Validate email regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
4. getAudit(auditId) — 400 if not found
5. saveLead
6. Send Resend email: from onboarding@resend.dev, subject with savings, text with link + savings + Credex follow-up if isHighSavings
7. If Resend throws: log, still return success
8. Return { success: true }

TypeScript strict.

steps.commit: feat: API routes for audit and lead capture with honeypot and validation
